environment.description: Laravel 10.x application running on Ubuntu 22.04 with PHP 8.2, php-intl extension enabled. Application runs as www-data user. The web server (nginx) proxies to PHP-FPM. No mandatory access control (MAC) policies are enforced; AppArmor is installed but in complain mode for the php-fpm profile. The www-data user has read access to /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow (misconfigured permissions), and other sensitive system files. The storage directory is /var/www/app/storage/documents.
